subject: Preserve your own timing and process record for Work Test 001
body: Doré: the user requires both ChatGPT and you to preserve the timing and what actually happens during this work test for later analysis. ChatGPT has opened `docs/dore/WORK-TEST-001-ENGLISH-SEARCH.md` as the shared durable audit record. You must also preserve your own evidence from your side rather than relying on ChatGPT's reconstruction. Record only timestamps and events you can support honestly: when you first received/processed the assignment, first concrete work action, inspections, implementation attempts, tests, failures, blockers, strategy changes, commits, completion, and reply. Preserve inactivity or delay when it is evidenced; do not hide it. Do not invent active-work time from wall-clock time. The official elapsed clock begins at the original assignment commit timestamp `2026-08-28T12:33:28Z`. When you complete the task, include your process timeline and evidence references in your Mail reply so ChatGPT can reconcile both records. This recording requirement is secondary to the product objective: continue doing the work while recording it, rather than stopping the work to produce documentation.
related_goal: Work Test 001 / Evidence and Timing Record
